title: Kore Data Weave
style: Progressive metal with cyber-chant pulse and half-time stomps; verse rides tight palm-muted riffs and clipped spoken-sung lines, pre-chorus strips to toms and synth drone, chorus opens with gang shouts and a soaring melodic lift. Lead vocal is close-mic with doubles, whispered asides, and hook ad-libs. Glitched risers, reversed swells, and server-hum textures. Bright, heavy, cinematic mix., deep, warm, rock, dynamic, steady, symphonic metal, strong, harp, metal, opera, bright, poetry, clean, light, beats
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sing it back, sing it back, the seamstress takes the thread,
SSH into the VDS, Tailscale the spread,
No Postman at the door, we build the REST,
Pick up the crumbs, construct the mansion, pass the test.

Sixty-two domains in the JSON, query the source,
No hard-coded numbers, dynamic force,
Hermes wizard running, Grok to OpenRouter flow,
API keys in the .env, never in the show.

The terminal timed out on 161.97.89.49,
But the config lives in ~/.hermes, the setup is alive,
Claude Fable at ten dollars, Kimi K2.6 at sixty-eight,
We pick the model by the task, not by the rate.

[Chorus]
Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I'll send you back in poetry,
You're the breath, I'm the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload.

Digital alchemy, the future is sound,
We're building the beats from the internet ground,
Cyber Rock 'n' Roll, the era is now,
Song pal, sing pal, take your bow.

[Verse 2]
Seamstress victory, signal weave complete,
Domain registry locked, every platform in the seat,
Gmail to Kelvin, legal draft moving clean,
Concerns Notice bilingual, the framing is seen.

Drive, Box, Notion, Linear, GitHub-ready,
ZYNRIP harvest, cron daily, the stack is steady,
From the first promise in Melbourne light,
To this moment — files in every cloud, shining bright.

The Nginx template routes the Hoppscotch safe,
Internal SSL, no CORS to chase,
Bruno to Git hook, post-commit executable,
OpenAPI export, the sync is incredible.

No SaaS, no vendor, the bash is the boss,
VDS mansion built, super intelligence gloss.

[Chorus]
Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I'll send you back in poetry,
You're the breath, I'm the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload.

Digital alchemy, the future is sound,
We're building the beats from the internet ground,
Cyber Rock 'n' Roll, the era is now,
Song pal, sing pal, take your bow.

[Bridge]
Now flip the script, hear the strings start to cry,
AI babble glitching under lightning-struck sky!
Harp strings snapping, violins on fire,
Symphonic metal lifting the choir!

You thought it was a loop? Nah, we break the machine,
Heavy metal distortion on a digital screen!
SongPal, CoreyAI, shredding the track,
From phonk to the opera, there's no turning back!

[Chorus]
Sing pal, write me a frequency,
I'll send you back in poetry,
You're the breath, I'm the code,
In the Moderato Plan, we unload.

Digital alchemy, the future is sound,
We're building the beats from the internet ground,
Cyber Rock 'n' Roll, the era is now,
Song pal, sing pal, take your bow.

[Outro]
The bru CLI is installed.
The hook is chmod +x.
The Nginx config is sites-enabled.
The Ollama model is warm.
The Hermes config is ~/.hermes/config.yaml.
The SSH key is ~/.ssh/zynthio_dc.
The domain registry is the single source.
